name: every-corner
description: Claude Code that works like a senior developer: it tours your codebase in plain English, interviews you before building so features land right the first time, and explains every risky command before you click Accept.

safetynet.title: Safety-net hook
safetynet.description: Warn before dangerous shell commands (rm -rf, git push --force, DROP TABLE and more) with a plain-English explanation and a safer option. Safe commands are never interrupted.
